title: List grid Actions column: a visible low-emphasis ⋯ on every row at rest, instead of a header over a column that looks empty until the pointer hovers a row
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filed by the record-page epic seat, part of epic #26676. The seat walked the console on `main` `c064d3a246`, with `examples/app-crm` as the backend, at 1440 / 1100 / 375 px, light and dark. An independent review pass then checked each finding against the code. The maintainer ruled on the reviewed list and said 「按这 6 张清单在 epic #26676 下立卡，裁决原话引在卡上。」 and 「还有刚才立的卡可以交给ui车道处理吗？」 (2026-11-02). So this card goes to the `domain:ui` lane queue. Priority and `area:*` are left to triage. Code readings below are on `main` `3b920f6dd0`.

## Observed

On the lead and opportunity lists at 1440 px, the last column is headed 操作, and the cells under it are empty until the pointer is over a row. A reader takes the column for "no actions available".

## Reading

- The header is always drawn: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridActionsColumn.tsx:181`, `t('grid.actions')`.
- The trigger is hidden at rest on a fine pointer: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx:731`, `opacity-0 … group-hover/row:opacity-100`.
- On touch (`pointer-coarse:opacity-100`) it is already visible. This card is about desktop.

## Target

- The row's ⋯ trigger is visible at rest in a muted tone, and full strength on row hover, focus, selection or an open menu.
- One state for every pointer type: the header and the buttons are present together.
- No new key and no new option.
- The enlarged related tab inherits this once it draws `object-grid` (#28865).

## Acceptance

- At 1440 px, every row shows its ⋯ without hover.
- The menu's set, gates and order are unchanged (#28434).
- The existing RowActionMenu tests pass, and a test pins the at-rest visibility.
